method: Renewed on 2026-11-13: the post and research file are byte-identical to the previously approved versions (content and research hashes match), the KCA comparison page and the EPA humidifier fact sheet were re-fetched and return HTTP 200, and the key figures were re-read from the source notes - 13 products tested, humidification output 182 to 606 ml/h (3.3 times spread), annual maintenance cost 4,640 to 6,420 won for ultrasonic versus 72,750 to 91,070 won for steam, steam at 99 degrees, noise 37 to 62 dB - so the approval is renewed without changing any claim. Re-checked on 2026-11-20 for the seven-day window: all 15 source URLs answered 200, and the Korea Consumer Agency consumer-magazine page was read again, still showing the 13-product test (1,000-consumer survey, 182 to 606 ml/h, up to 3.3 times, 12.9 to 42.9 square metres of coverage), the annual upkeep ranges (ultrasonic 4,640 to 6,420 won, heating 72,750 to 91,070 won, evaporative 5,330 to 108,330 won, hybrid 15,780 to 189,290 won), 37 to 62 dB noise and the 99 degree steam of the three heating models with 55 degree surfaces. Body and research files are unchanged.
note: 2026-11-27 12:40 KST 7일 검증 갱신: 공식 출처를 gate --online으로 재확인했다. 한전 페이지 1건은 응답 없음 경고가 남았으나 다른 출처는 정상이며, 본문·조사 기록 해시는 바꾸지 않았다.
